rules.title: Use a clear business-intelligence title. Do not use hype.
rules.introduction: Start with 1-2 calm framing paragraphs before key takeaways.

key_takeaways.format: Each key takeaway must link to a later article section using markdown anchor links.

content_sections.description: Use clear analytical sections. Explain what happened, what the data shows, and the underlying mechanism.

why_it_matters_to_business.description: Explain practical relevance for operators, investors, planners, and decision makers.

transparency_panel.description: Include confidence, evidence base, data coverage, primary mechanism, limitations, and source notes.

sources.description: List source names, tables, rows, dates, and URLs where available.

tone: Calm, factual, structured, business-oriented, institutional. Avoid hype.
